name: mscse-semester-below-graduate-level
description: DGS 2026-10-03 (P1-residency-enrollment-c5, suggested fix): Academic Code §4.1 expects every full-time graduate student to register for at least 3 credits at the 60000 level or higher each semester, unless the Graduate School’s associate dean for academic affairs permits otherwise. A Fall 2026 of three 40000-level courses (9 credits) is still full-time and still counts toward the MSCSE’s one semester of residence, but the row goes to the DGS instead of Met and names the semester; the review request carries the same note.

detailIncludes: Fall 2026: fewer than 3 credits at the 60000 level or higher
